verdict.rationale: Better Auth is a self-hosted library that stores all auth data in your own standard database (SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and more), so the data is already in open, portable formats you control. Community users independently confirm they own the data, are not tied to any DB provider, and that the adapter design makes switching to another library easy. missing for 10: a documented first-party export or migration-out workflow, and explicit guidance on exporting data in open file formats rather than relying on direct database access.
